flags.why: The conventional word for a cat's cry is meo, not méo ([dictionary](https://www.thuvienlamdong.org.vn/Files/Books/53119.pdf)).
Dẫn điện means to conduct electricity; khả năng supplies the meaning of ability or capacity in the example.
flags.fix: Remove sense 2; electrical conductivity is tính dẫn điện or độ dẫn điện.

flags.why: The entry omits the common meaning of feeling anxious or apprehensive ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ph%E1%BA%ADp%20ph%E1%BB%93ng)).
flags.fix: Add: adj | anxious; apprehensive. Example: Cô ấy phập phồng lo sợ bị phát hiện. = She was anxious about being discovered.

flags.why: Sai phạm does not naturally take nhiều quy định as a direct object in this sentence.
flags.fix: Công ty đã sai phạm trong việc thực hiện các quy định về an toàn. = The company committed violations in implementing the safety regulations.

flags.why: Learners are most likely to encounter sai phạm as a noun meaning violation or wrongdoing.
